title: Sharing a Flat Again
sentences: At thirty-four I moved back into a shared flat.
I had lived alone for six years and thought I preferred it.
Rents in the city had risen faster than my salary.
My two flatmates are both younger and considerably tidier than me.
We agreed on a cleaning rota in the first week.
It works, mostly because one of them reminds the rest of us.
The evenings are noisier than I had grown used to.
On the other hand, I have not eaten dinner alone since I arrived.
I am saving nearly four hundred dollars a month.
I had assumed this would feel like a step backwards, and it does not.
